provenance.source: AnthroForge preset-layer driver: no mesh instance; consumed by coupling records in library/couplings/

range.endpoint_anchor: driver value only; effects are defined by the coupling records that read it

region.mask_rule: no vertex region: preset-layer driver, not a mesh morph

semantics: Master pole dial (BARA_LESSONS A5): 0 = full tissue thesis (strongman end), 1 = full definition thesis (bodybuilder end). The dial coupling linearly interpolates the two orc sub-presets' tissue vectors: definition family up, MassSmooth and Chubby down. Fills only sliders the character has not set explicitly.
